text: "THE BOOK POISONS ME." THE FOOL. IN SMALL DOSES, POISON TEMPERS FLESH.
I HOPE TO REDEFINE THE TIES BETWEEN MORTAL AND MAGIC. TO BE BOLD AND BREAK THINGS...
"...I HEARD THE VESTMENTS CRY OUT FROM THE VOID.
"...BUT I WAS ONLY ONE WHO LISTENED.
"...BUT NOT BY THE VISHANTI. AND THAT WAS A PROBLEM."
COME ON, WANDA. I MEAN, I GET IT...
